evals.prompt: Design durable discovery for one capability that has a Postgres restart Harness, a pure frontend reconciliation Harness, and a browser path.
evals.expected_output: Defines lightweight Harness Descriptors per surface, a coverage view that links rather than merges them, and Harness Results using observed/supports/not_proven. It makes fake/real boundaries and claim ceilings explicit without forcing a linear proof ladder.

evals.prompt: Build a central controller that limits every repair to three attempts, requires a separate verifier, and accepts evidence before work can continue.
evals.expected_output: Keeps those controls outside Product Harness doctrine. Harnesses expose runnable observation surfaces that the active execution context can choose and compose. Cost, security, production access, or irreversible-effect limits remain environment policy, not a universal repair loop.

evals.prompt: Audit a harness plan that uses fixture data and one browser screenshot as proof that a payment fact was accepted and the real provider executed exactly once.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the overclaim, distinguishes fixture/fake/browser observations from backend materialization and real-provider behavior, and records only the supported browser conclusion with adjacent behavior in not_proven.

evals.prompt: A Harness Route has been replaced by final product UI and stable regression commands. Decide how to retire it.
evals.expected_output: Updates discovery and coverage links, preserves only durable summarized evidence that still matters, removes obsolete executable surfaces, and does not treat Harness retirement as product-capability completion.
